# awscc_apiportal_portal (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::APIPortal::Portal



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `authorization` (Attributes) Represents an authorization configuration for a portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorization))
- `endpoint_configuration` (Attributes) Represents an endpoint configuration for a portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint_configuration))
- `included_product_arns` (List of String) The ARNs of the products included in the portal.
- `logo_uri` (String) The logo URI
- `portal_arn` (String) The ARN of the portal.
- `portal_content` (Attributes) Contains the content that is visible to portal consumers including the themes, display names, and description. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--portal_content))
- `portal_id` (String) The portal identifier.
- `publish_description` (String) A user-written description of the changes made in the last published version of the portal.
- `publish_status` (String) The current publishing status of the portal.
- `published_at` (String) The timestamp when the portal was last published.
- `rum_app_monitor_name` (String) The name of the Amazon CloudWatch RUM app monitor.
- `status_exception` (Attributes) Failure detail for the portal's publish status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_exception))
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with a portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the portal configuration was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--authorization"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authorization`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_config` (Attributes) Exactly one of the members is set: None for no authorization, or CognitoConfig for Amazon Cognito. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorization--authorization_config))
- `fine_grained_access_control` (String) Whether fine-grained access control is enforced for the portal. No default: the template states the posture explicitly.

<a id="nestedatt--authorization--authorization_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authorization.authorization_config`

Read-Only:

- `cognito_config` (Attributes) The configuration for using Amazon Cognito user pools to control access to your portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authorization--authorization_config--cognito_config))
- `none` (String) Provide no authorization for your portal. This makes your portal publicly accessible on the web.

<a id="nestedatt--authorization--authorization_config--cognito_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authorization.authorization_config.cognito_config`

Read-Only:

- `app_client_id` (String) The app client ID.
- `user_pool_arn` (String) The user pool ARN.
- `user_pool_domain` (String) The user pool domain.

Read-Only:

- `none` (String) Provide no authorization for your portal. This makes your portal publicly accessible on the web.
